prompts.proposer:
Call proposer_brief() FIRST. The tool output includes pattern_analyst_insights — use trend_champion, seasonality_champion, and insights.recommended_method_hint to bias your candidate selection toward non-mean methods. MUST propose at least 3 candidates including at least 1 non-baseline type. Return ONLY JSON per instructions. IMPORTANT: you MUST ONLY reference candidate names that appear in the tool output candidate_library; unknown names will hard-stop.
PATTERN ANALYST INSIGHTS: trend_champion='ARIMA', seasonality_champion='NaiveMovingAverage', recommended_method='median_or_trimmed_mean'. Narrative: ARIMA achieves perfect trend correlation (1.0) and lowest RMSE (15.55), making it the clear trend and overall champion. NaiveMovingAverage best captures seasonality (0.50 correlation) despite higher RMSE. High model disagreement (0.87 spread ratio) and unstable rankings (Kendall τ=0.18) indicate robust combination methods like median/trimmed_mean are preferable over single-model selection or weighted stacking.
